item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:50 HKT 07/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Heavy showers and squally thunderstorms associated with a monsoon depression will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today. A trough of low pressure is expected to form over the inland areas of southern China, and move towards the coastal areas gradually. Under its influence, there will still be showers over the coastal areas in the latter part of this week to early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Guchol will move across the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
